Caveman2Cosmos is a fan-made mod for Civilization IV: Beyond the Sword. It has a wide variety of new content and artwork, and as its name suggests starts players out in the Prehistoric era, all the way to Space exploration. It starts in 200000 BC, and has 14 eras: Prehistoric, Ancient, Classical, Medieval, Renaissance, Industrial, Atomic, Information, Nanotech, Transhuman, Galactic, Cosmic, Transcendent, and Future (which can't be reached). Caveman2Cosmos was first released in 2010, by StrategyOnly, as a spiritual successor to Rise of Mankind: A New Dawn. It has received almost daily updates by StrategyOnly and over 100 of his fellow CivFanatics modding team members ever since.

The Churchill tank is the more powerful of the two tanks that the British used in World War 2. These tanks are found on the global World War 2 scenario. These were the longest serving tanks in the time period they served from 1941 to 1952.

Sid Meier's Civilization IV: Beyond the Sword is the second official expansion pack of the critically acclaimed turn-based strategy video game Civilization IV. It was released in July 2007. The expansion focuses on adding content to the in-game time periods following the invention of gunpowder, and includes more general content such as 11 new scenarios, 10 new civilizations, and 16 new leaders.

New to Beyond the Sword is the ability to make colonies of your empire. To do this you must have at least three cities on a landmass other than your home continent (where the capital is). Opening up the domestic screen will then open up this option. Note that you can only form one colony on each continent; any other liberation on a continent which has a colony of yours already will immediately be given over to the preexisting colony. After creating a colony it will immediately become a vassal (even if you do not have Feudalism yet); you will get a +10 relations boost because they are your colony, and you will be able to demand any resource from them that you do not have. They will start with any of the cities you have chosen to release (and you can liberate more to them if they are on the same continent). They will also be given automatic defense units, and will start with every technology you had when they were turned into a colony. Colony leaders are chosen by the most similar cultures. For example: Britain makes a colony. It is lead by the Americans. If a colony is mistreated, it may break off and form a completely independent empire, in which case it is time to "send in the troops."

In C-evo, the three resources Cobalt, Mercury, and Uranium are the rare elements ("modern resources") essential for building the transstellar colony ship. They appear only after you have acquired Mass Production on tiles that were known only as dead lands. Construction of the colony ship parts can be started only after you have a Space Port. For each turn in which a city is set to work on building the requisite part of the ship, one of its workers must be on the rare element tile. If no worker is, nothing is produced in that turn. The elements are used as follows: *Cobalt: Colony Ship Component - needing 6, totalling 1,440 resources *Mercury: Habitation Module - needing 2, totalling 1,600 resources *Uranium: Power Module - needing 4, totalling 2,400 resources

Oceans produce small amounts of food and no production, but substantial trade. Only ships or aircraft can enter Oceans. Landlocked Oceans are really lakes but are treated like other Oceans in all respects. Oceans produce 1 food and 2 trade. Fish can be found in oceans which generate an extra 2 food. With railroad (place a settler on a ship in order to accomplish) the oceans produce one extra trade. An extra unit of trade can be produced by switching to a democracy or republic. It costs 1 Movement Point to travel over an ocean region, but only ships and aircraft can do so.

Nuclear weapons must be placed in a city or on a Carrier at the end of every turn (unless they are used to attack). Nuclear weapons may ignore zones of control and are invisible to enemy players. The Manhattan Project must be constructed to allow the construction of Nuclear weapons. When used on land, Nuclear weapons destroy every unit in the target square and each adjacent square, and will halve the population of a city if used on one; however, they cause pollution in each of these squares. They can be used against enemy naval units without the consequences of pollution. The only defense against Nuclear weapons is the SDI Defense.

The Renault 1935 is a French tank that the nation of France had deployed during the opening of World War II. These tanks were very fast but they were small and could not hold as many troops as their S-35 cousins. These tanks are best used as scouts to probe areas to see if there are enemies nearby and return to re-group. If there's an entire stack of these tanks grouped they can do extreme damage to a German tank division, but it is not recommended because their tanks were designed primarily as offensive tanks. R-35's were designed as lightly armored troop support.

A "transport multiplier" in the free game C-evo is simply the number of air units that can be carried in one module on a Carrier or the number of ground units that can be carried in one module on an air unit or a naval unit. Initially each is set at 2, from the discovery of Combined Arms for air transport, and from the discovery of Map Making for unit transport on naval units. Later advances make some increases. In all cases, there is no numerical limit on the number of transport modules, but each module takes up part of the weight quota.

A Fighting Chance is a weapon shop located in the Imperial City Market District. The proprietor of the store is Rohssan, who, aside from trading, offers weapon and armor repair, while also being an Apprentice armorer trainer. Rohssan has 1200 and a Mercantile skill of 80. When bartering, she will buy weapons, armor and miscellaneous items whilst only selling blades. Her wares include the unique Battleaxe of Hatred, which has damage Strength, Endurance and Willpower enchantments. Rohssan also offers repair services and advanced Armorer training.

A Mage's Staff is a quest in . This is the first quest after the Hero's full initiation into the Arcane University. Apprentices travel to Wellspring Cave, upon becoming full-fledged members of the guild to craft a staff as a customary rite.

A Blade in the Dark is a quest available in in which the Dragonborn must slay a dragon to prove to Delphine that they are the Dragonborn. They are tasked with traveling to Kynesgrove with Delphine to kill the dragon Sahloknir after being resurrected from his burial mound by Alduin after which Delphine will trust the Dragonborn with her identity as a Blade and invite them to assist in investigating the resurgence of dragons.
A Night to Remember is a Daedric quest available in . Sam Guevenne has a drinking contest with the Dragonborn and promises a staff to the winner.

A Carved Ebony Dart is a throwing weapon in . Its stats are identical to a regular Ebony Dart. It is acquirable by killing the Dark Brotherhood assassin that disrupt the Nerevarine's sleep during the main questline. Because enemies tend to use ranged weapons over melee weapons, you must kill the assassin before he can strike (either through Paralysis or using Invisibility).

A Beginning at Bleakrock is a quest available in . An unknown ship has been spotted near Bleakrock Isle, and the Vestige is asked to help gather the villagers in case they have to evacuate. If the Vestige arrived on Bleakrock via the Gates of Adamant, Cadwell's Silver, or Cadwell's Gold, they awake in Captain Rana's Office in Bleakrock Village. The quest can be received from either Riurik in Davon's Watch, or Captain Rana on the upper floor of her office. It is no longer available after starting What Waits Beneath, The Frozen Man, or Hozzin's Folly. Adding is a Nord Barbarian who resides near Esutanamus, a shrine to Molag Bal, in the Azura's Coast region. He wields a Nordic Battle Axe and wears full Bonemold Armor, aside from the helmet.

Agnete the Pickled is a Nord blacksmith who runs the Hammer and Tongs in Skingrad, closer to the West Gate. The Hero may hear rumors from fellow Skingrad residents that they shouldn't visit Agnete's shop early in the morning because she usually isn't feeling well then. This rumor is mostly true mainly because Agnete often has hangovers after a night of drinking heavily at Two Sisters Lodge, which concerns many of the townsfolk. Nevertheless, she still sells many things during the day which include weapons, armor, and offers repair services anytime.
The Akaviri Sword is a unique Blades Sword found in . It is physically and statistically identical to the Blades Sword.
Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking are a unique pair of Ancient Nord Boots and part of Ahzidal's Armor set.
Ahzidal's Gauntlets of Warding are a unique pair of Ancient Nord Gauntlets and part of the unique Ahzidal's Armor set found in .
Ahzidal's Armor of Retribution is a unique piece of Ancient Nord Armor and part of Ahzidal's Armor set found in .
Ahzidal's Helm of Vision is a unique Ancient Nord Helmet and part of Ahzidal's Armor set found in .

Ahzidal's Armor is a unique set of ancient Nord armor found in . Despite being identical to ancient Nord armor in appearance, it has a higher base armor rating and weighs more. Ahzidal's armor matches steel plate armor in terms of armor rating.
Akaviri Dragonguard is an overland set in . It is obtained from overland content in Eastmarch. Generic pieces are Heavy Armor in Nord Style.
Afzoon is a Redguard found near the grave of Master Ahtar in the town of Leki's Blade.
Ah-Seeba is an Argonian found on the retired ship, The Blasted Breton, in Alten Corimont.
Agnenor the Blade, also known as Agnenor Storm-Blade, is a Nord member of the Stormfist Clan found in The Bastard's Tomb. She is the author of Letter from Agenor.
Affliction is an armor set that appears in . It can be obtained in Cyrodiil. It can be bought from Elite Gear Vendors in "Offensive Heavy Boxes."

Alcalime is an Altmer soldier found in Eagle's Strand. She has been wounded during the ship crash and is now being treated for her wounds. She does not really mind her wounds and would rather see how the others have healed so they can stop whining.
Aldcroft Anvil & Armor is one of several local markets in Aldcroft. It is located opposite the Dockside Green market near the docks. Inside are three vendors and three crafting stations.
Alcaire Banneret's Helm is a heavy armor helm, given to the Vestige after completing the quest "The Safety of the Kingdom."

An Altar of Enchanting is what is used to enchant a non-magical weapon or item using a Soul Gem. Using an Altar of Enchanting requires access into the Arcane University in except with the Frostcrag Spire plug-in.

Alix Lencolia is a Breton citizen located at Faregyl Inn northwest of Bravil. He is a Master with the Blade and his skill is known throughout Cyrodiil. Some say he will become a legend one day, seeing that he is as skilled as he is at such a young age.
Almsivi Restore Fighter is a Restoration spell in that restores all Warrior skills. This spell can only be activated by using a Shrine of the Tribunal.
Almalexia's Shield is an ability possessed by Gavas Drin , the Dunmer priest. This ability consists of a variety of magic effects that protect the caster from magical and physical attacks.
Almalexia's Mercy is an item set in . It is a Light Armor set, and can be found in Cyrodiil. Pieces are in the Alliance styles.
Alexandra's Froststaff is an ice staff found in . It is part of the Shalk Exoskeleton Set.

The Alik'ri Fishing Rod is a tool and one-handed weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Fishing. It is a variant of the regular Fishing Rod of Redguard making, bearing the name of the Alik'r Desert.
An-Zaw is an Argonian Nightblade residing in the Suran tradehouse. He is a member of the Mages Guild and a Skill trainer. He can train the Nerevarine in Illusion, Mysticism, and Alteration.

Amber is a material that is used to make a special Amber Armor and Amber Weapons in the Shivering Isles. The armor is put into the "Light Armor" category. It can be found on Gnarls or in amber stumps that are mainly found underground.
Amber Armor is one of the sets of light armor available with expansion. It is forged from amber ore, which can be found in deposits in Root Tunnels or on Gnarls.

Amber Weapons are one of the two weapon sets introduced in 's plug-in, . Five weapons exist in the set, a bow with arrows, a hammer, a mace, and a one-handed sword. As with other unenchanted weapons, they are ineffective against ghosts and wraiths.

Amber Bows can be forged from amber by the smith Dumag gro-Bonk, who operates The Missing Pauldron in Bliss. He can forge one bow from two pieces of amber ore. Providing a bow matrix will yield an enchanted bow. The quality of the bow and, if applicable, its enchantment, is scaled to the Hero's level at the time when gro-Bonk makes it. A maximum quality bow is equal in strength to a Daedric bow.

Amber Helmets can be forged from amber by the smith Dumag gro-Bonk, who operates The Missing Pauldron in Bliss. He can forge one helmet from two pieces of amber ore. Providing an amber helmet matrix will cause the helmet to be enchanted, as well. The quality of the helmet and, if applicable, its enchantment is scaled to the Hero's level at the time when asking gro-Bonk to make it.

An Amber Shield can be forged from amber by the smith Dumag gro-Bonk, who operates The Missing Pauldron in Bliss. He can forge one shield from two pieces of amber ore. Providing an amber shield matrix will cause the shield to be enchanted, as well. The quality of the shield and, if applicable, its enchantment is scaled to the Hero's level at the time when asking gro-Bonk to make it.
Amulet of Disintegration is an enchanted amulet with very powerful Disintegrate Armor and Disintegrate Weapon enchantments. This amulet is needed for "The Coming Storm" quest.
Amren's Sword is a quest available in in which the Dragonborn must recover a family sword for Amren which has been stolen by bandits in Whiterun Hold.

Anarenen's Devil Tanto is a unique steel tanto that belongs to Anarenen of the Mages Guild. This one-handed short blade is enchanted to shield the user against Fire Damage, and equip a magical weightless Daedric dagger that increases Short Blade skill.
The Amulet is an item in that can be worn. It gives a -1 armor bonus on each part of the body.
Amulet of Sanguine Nimble Armor is a unique extravagant sapphire amulet. It is enchanted to increase the wearer's Light Armor skill.
An Axe to Find is a miscellaneous quest in in which the Dragonborn must return an Ancient Nordic pickaxe to Glover Mallory in Raven Rock from Crescius Caerellius.

Amphibian is an Argonian passive skill in . It is unlocked by default. This skill increases experience when using the Restoration Staff skill line by 15%, as well as swimming speed by 50%. This skill replaced Restoration Expertise in Update 11.
Amulet of Shield is an enchanted amulet in . The amulet will provide the shield effect to its wearer.
Amber Plasm is a dungeon set that appears in . It is a Light Armor set, and can be found in Ruins of Mazzzatun. It was added with Shadows of the Hist, one of the DLCs.
Amarz the Shield-Maker is a Redguard woodworker and member of the Fighters Guild residing in the guildhall in the Saint Delyn Waistworks of Vivec City.

Amber War Axe is a type of war axe that appears in / and is a part of the Creation Club addon Saints & Seducers. It can be crafted using refined amber, refined moonstone and leather strips. It is as powerful as its dragonbone counterpart, but weighs less.
Ancestral Sword of Clan Ice-Blade is a weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon The Gray Cowl Returns!.
The Ancient Shrouded Cowl is a unique Shrouded Cowl and part of the Ancient Shrouded Armor set found in .
Angi's Bow is a unique hunting bow found in . Aside from its name, it is identical to a regular hunting bow.

The set does not include a shield. Relatively rare, it cannot be collected from draugr, or crafted under normal circumstances.

The Ancient Helmet of the Unburned is a unique Ancient Nord Helmet found in . This helmet is unique in the fact that it provides an elemental resistance, while being an item worn on the head. Elemental resistances are usually limited to shields, boots and jewelry.

The Ancient Nord Helmet is a piece of heavy armor and a part of the Ancient Nord Armor set found in . It is a variant of the iron helmet and has similar base attributes. However, what makes it superior is that it benefits from the Daedric Smithing perk, which vastly improves its armor rating when upgraded. This makes it comparable with some of the higher tier armors.

This makes them comparable with some of the higher tier armors.

Ancient Nordic Pickaxe is a one-handed weapon found in Solstheim. It is the only kind of pickaxe that is capable of mining Stalhrim, as well as being capable of mining anything that can be mined with a normal pickaxe. By the Fourth Era, there are very few of the pickaxes remaining. It can be enchanted, but cannot be improved with Smithing.

Anka-Ra War-Priest is a Yokudan Ra Gada warrior carrying a sword and shield, along with a yellow banner on his back. Anka-Ra War-Priests are found exclusively within the Hel Ra Citadel Trial.

The Apron of Adroitness is an enchanted piece of armor with fortify attributes. It is also a quest reward received from the quest "A Brush With Death."
Anvil Shield is a special Light Iron Shield equipped by members of the Anvil Guard. It differs only in appearance, and bears the seal of Anvil.
Apparel are different types of garments or body gear found in . Apparel can be divided in categories: *Clothing *Armor *Shields *Jewelry

The Ansei were a renowned group of warriors of the Redguards. They were the most masterful of the Sword-Singers, who were known for creating a spirit sword known as the Shehai. Makela Leki, the author of From the Memory Stone of Makela Leki, was a second-level Ansei.
Anora's Club is a weapon in . It is a unique weapon, but can only be obtained using console commands. It is a unique variation of a Daedric Club.

Apprentice's Armorer's Hammer is an item in that, when used on either weapons or armor, increases the Armorer skill. It can be used a total of 10 times before the item disappears from the character's inventory.

Apotheosis is a powerful staff that inflicts fire, frost, and shock damage to its target. The staff has the power to kill guards or other higher level entities in a couple hits. It also has a unique attack appearance, as it fires the shock-type attack, but leaves the "misty" aura residue of a Frost attack.
